actions.description: Read linear acceleration, angular velocity and orientation from an inertial measurement unit, with the declared reference frame and timestamp.

inputs.description: Reference frame for the returned vectors: 'body' preserves the sensor_msgs/Imu vectors, while 'world' rotates them by the reported orientation quaternion. The pinned publisher fills only orientation, so both vectors are zero there.
inputs.name: frame

actions.name: read_imu

facts.text: Ros2TrackIMUDriver is an rclpy Node constructed with the name 'track_imu_driver'.
The node imports the ROS 2 sensor_msgs.msg.Imu message.
The constructor creates a publisher for Imu on the relative topic name 'imu' with queue size 10.
The constructor also creates a DiagnosticArray publisher on the relative topic name 'diagnostics' with queue size 10.
The node declares a frame_id parameter whose default is the string 'base_imu_link'.
The constructor fills the orientation, angular-velocity and linear-acceleration covariance diagonals with 0.0025, 0.02 and 0.04 based on the comments' noise estimates.
publish_imu_data decodes a UTF-8 line, strips the 'ypr,' prefix and tab characters, and splits the remaining text on commas.

For a line with more than two comma-separated fields, the node negates yaw, adds imu_yaw_calibration, wraps yaw to [-180, 180], negates pitch, and converts yaw, pitch and roll from degrees to radians.
publish_imu_data assigns the local yaw, pitch and roll only when the line has more than two comma-separated fields, and calls quaternion_from_euler with them after that branch.
The node imports transforms3d.euler.euler2quat under the name quaternion_from_euler.
The node converts roll, pitch and yaw with quaternion_from_euler and assigns q[0], q[1], q[2] and q[3] to orientation x, y, z and w.
The node stamps the Imu header from its clock, sets the configured frame_id, increments a sequence counter and publishes the message on 'imu'.
The linear_acceleration and angular_velocity assignment lines in publish_imu_data are commented out.
The node publishes a DiagnosticArray named 'Track_IMU' at level OK with message 'Received AHRS measurement', roll/yaw/pitch in degrees and the sequence number.
imu_node.main declares the port parameter with default '/dev/tty.usbmodemHIDFH1' and the baud parameter with default 115200, then opens serial.Serial with a one-second timeout.
The main loop flushes the first 200 serial lines, reads one line per iteration and calls publish_imu_data until rclpy is no longer OK.
The calls to configure_imu and to start the datastream with '#o1' are commented out in main.
The README documents 'ros2 run ros2_track_imu imu_node' as the usage command.
The README's launch section says ROS 2 launch is not implemented yet.
The publisher launch file track-imu-pub.py is a commented-out ROS 1 launch snippet.
package.xml declares an ament_python package with exec dependencies rclpy, python-serial, sensor_msgs and diagnostics_msgs.
setup.py registers the console script ros2_track_imu = ros2_track_imu.nodes.imu_node:main.
The accelerometer, magnetometer, gyroscope and yaw-calibration values are declared ROS parameters with constructor defaults.

safe_state.description: The node is a passive IMU publisher: it exposes no actuation, stop or reset service, and this package binds only its observation topic, so it commands no safe state.
